findings.title: Owner check missing
findings.impact: An authenticated member could receive another member’s record.
findings.fix: Scope the database lookup to the current user.

findings.title: Private fields in profile response
findings.impact: Returning the full user row would disclose a stored password verifier to the signed-in user.
findings.fix: Select the two public profile fields explicitly.
findings.before:
row = db().execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?", (session["uid"],)).fetchone()
return jsonify(dict(row))
findings.after:
row = db().execute("SELECT display, role FROM users WHERE id=?", (session["uid"],)).fetchone()
        return jsonify(dict(row))

findings.title: Unbounded profile display name
findings.impact: Whitespace or oversized names could enter persistent records and disrupt profile rendering.
findings.fix: Validate type and trimmed length before writing.
findings.before:
display = body()["display"]
db().execute("UPDATE users SET display=? WHERE id=?", (display, session["uid"]))

findings.title: Missing administrator check
findings.impact: Any authenticated account could read a restricted aggregate count.
findings.fix: Read the role from the database and deny unauthorized access.
